items.title: Backend .NET Software Engineer - Payments
items.description: About the Role Are you an experienced Backend Software Engineer ready for your next challenge? The Payments Engineering Area is hiring! Payments Engineering is responsible for building the best payment customer experience from payment pages perspective and improving the offering of different payment options across global brands and markets that we operate within. We are an international team with some of the best people in the industry! If you are passionate about the latest technologies and can handle company-critical responsibilities, then this is the role for you! What You’ll Work On Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable server-side applications using the .NET framework and related technologies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including front-end developers, product managers, and designers, to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications. Develop and implement efficient and secure RESTful APIs and microservices to support client applications and integrations. Perform thorough testing and debugging of backend applications to ensure high quality and reliability. Optimise application performance and scalability through code optimisations, caching strategies, and database optimisations. Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, adherence to architectural guidelines, and best practices. What You Bring Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS). Strong background in backend development, with experience in languages such as C#/.Net Knowledge of NoSQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server databases. Experience in design and implementation of distributed systems that comprise of multiple domain-oriented services. Understanding of front-end development technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Familiarity with version control systems, preferably Git. Familiarity with containerisation technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes. Strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns. Proficiency in SQL databases both in writing queries and optimising performance Effective communication skills in English, both verbal and written, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Stay updated with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in backend development and actively contribute to improving development processes and efficiency. Nice to Have Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. We don’t expect you to be an expert in all these technologies but would anticipate experience with some combined with a curiosity for others: etcd, Consul, Redis, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, gRPC, Orleans. Benefits Hybrid working model Private health insurance Life insurance Wellness allowance Home office set-up allowance 24 days annual holiday leave + additional days for public holidays falling on weekends Flexible compensation benefits Remote working from abroad options Who We Are Betsson Group is one of the largest companies within the Global iGaming space and can trace our heritage as far back as the 1960’s. We’re Swedish and publicly listed too with our Operational HQ located on the Mediterranean Island of Malta. We strive to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. As a market leader within iGaming we offer online gaming products across 12+ jurisdictions and 20+ brands. You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi-brand platform used by hundreds of thousands of our customers! Product Development at Betsson Group Our Product Development organisation is truly Global with cross functional teams spanning 6 Tech Hubs – Malta, Budapest, Stockholm, Tallinn, Malaga and Athens. With around 1,000 strong professionals, the Product Development organisation is spear-headed by our CTO-CPO with all our talented Area Teams working together. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your next step, please submit your CV in English. By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.title: Junior VIP Host - English Speaking
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We’re looking for a Junior VIP Host to build meaningful relationships and deliver personalised service to Stake’s most valued players at Easygo a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and live-streaming platforms. You’ll become a trusted point of contact for your own portfolio of VIP players, working closely with our wider VIP team to ensure every player feels valued, supported, and engaged. What you'll build with us: We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity based in Melbourne, with a unique split-shift structure combining time in our office with remote evening work to support our global VIP community. . You’ll manage a dedicated portfolio of approximately 350 VIP players , building lasting relationships through proactive communication, personalised rewards, and tailored experiences. Alongside resolving customer enquiries, you’ll develop a deep understanding of Stake’s products and player behaviours, helping us continually elevate the VIP experience. Who is Easygo? We're a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We're building the future of fearless tech. We're the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that's where the real fun happens. We're always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you'll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can't get anywhere else. Please note that in this role our team works 6 days a week for 6 hours a day. Your hours and location of work are below: Mon - Friday - 9am - 2pm (Office) Mon - Friday - 9pm - 11pm (Home) Saturday Or Sunday: 9am - 2pm + 9pm - 11pm (Home) The impact you’ll make: Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with a dedicated portfolio of approximately 350 VIP players, delivering personalised service that makes every interaction count. Act as the primary point of contact for your VIP players, understanding their individual preferences, needs and behaviours to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Proactively engage with players to build rapport, strengthen relationships and encourage long-term loyalty. Manage player enquiries from start to finish, ensuring timely responses, effective problem-solving and positive outcomes. Deliver tailored rewards, bonuses and cashback offers in line with established processes and player needs. Use communication platforms including live chat, email and Telegram to maintain meaningful and consistent engagement with VIP players. Monitor player activity, behaviours and trends, using insights to identify opportunities to improve the overall VIP experience. Collaborate with internal teams to resolve complex enquiries, escalate concerns and ensure a seamless player experience. Work closely with VIP Managers, Supervisors and Senior Hosts to achieve team KPIs and continuously improve service standards. Your track record: Minimum 1 year's experience in a customer service environment, ideally within hospitality, sales, account management or a similar customer-facing role. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build genuine relationships and adapt your approach to different personalities. A customer-first mindset with a genuine passion for delivering exceptional, personalised service. Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, particularly when managing challenging customer interactions. Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple conversations and priorities simultaneously. A proactive, solutions-focused approach with the ability to take ownership of customer enquiries and follow through to resolution. Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn new systems, products and processes. Comfortable working towards KPIs and contributing to a collaborative, high-performing team. Confidence using digital communication platforms and customer management systems. Bonus points if you also have: Previous experience within the wagering, iGaming or online casino industry. Knowledge of cryptocurrency, sports betting or casino products. Experience managing customer portfolios, VIP relationships or customer retention. Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Jira or Intercom. Benefits that give you the Easygo Edge, so you can build the future of fearless tech with us: Disrupt: we push boundaries and play to win Ballots for major sporting and music events Time with our partners and ambassadors, and exclusive office sessions with leading streamers, creators and industry guests Spin the Wheel Fridays on your birthday and work anniversary, with prizes up to $1,000 or a car EV subscriptions, novated leasing, energy savings through Origin, and everyday discounts and cash back through Paylab Rewards Evolve: we’re in constant motion, personally and professionally The ultimate sandbox: 1 in 3 of our people level up their role every year. If you deliver, you move. Market-synced pay, a performance-based bonus and a high-value referral bonus 30 days combined annual and personal leave for full-time employees 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers and 2 weeks for secondary carers, plus a 12-week return to work with fully paid Fridays off Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, and 7% off Bupa health cover with extras waiting periods waived Wednesday massages, a meditation space, parenting facilities, and bike storage, lockers and showers for active commuters Unify: we move as one and win together Daily catered breakfast, free barista coffee, juices and smoothies, and snack walls and drink fridges on every floor Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles, an F1 simulator, social sports teams and the Corporate Games Mid-year and end-of-year celebrations, team budgets for wins and milestones, and a paid volunteer day each year Benefits apply to Australian-based employees, are subject to eligibility and program terms, and may change. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Applied AI Architect, OpenAI for Government
items.description: About the Team The OpenAI for Government AI Architect team partners with public sector organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with government agencies, public institutions, and partner organizations serving the government to identify where AI can advance critical missions, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Global Affairs, and specialist delivery teams to help public sector customers adopt advanced AI responsibly and effectively. About the Role As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will shape each customer's AI strategy and guide their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable mission impact. You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate mission priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value. The Account Director leads the overall account strategy and relationship, while you lead the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production impact. You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong public sector fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations. This role is based in Munich or London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of public sector customers and pre-sales prospects. - Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities. - Lead discovery with agency leaders, mission owners, executives, and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful mission and operational outcomes. - Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment. - Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, building confidence in both the solution and its path to production. - Help customers navigate the security, compliance, governance, and deployment requirements that shape AI adoption in the public sector. - Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans. - Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Chief Data and AI Officers, program leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders. - Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, security, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams. - Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged. - Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable mission impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization. - Apply public sector and mission expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities. - Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success. - Have guided complex organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable impact. - Have experience working with government agencies, public institutions, or government contractors and understand how mission priorities, security, compliance, governance, and procurement considerations shape technology adoption. - Build credibility with senior technical and government leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers and program teams. - Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy. - Understand modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, and enterprise AI workflows. - Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript. - Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to establish clear handoffs and ownership. - Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes. - Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant public sector mission or customer segment. - Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan. - Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping public sector organizations deploy advanced AI safely and responsibly. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. items.title: Identity Engineer
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? The Identity Engineer will help build - not just run - a new identity platform that every person, system and AI agent at Easygo authenticates through. What you’ll build with us: It’s a greenfield project: standing up a modern cloud identity platform, and operationalising it. The foundation is only the start and we have so much more to build on top of that ncluding identity and security for agentic AI. Alongside delivery, you'll be the identity subject-matter expert — partnering with engineering and product teams so they can build fast without having to worry about identity, making secure authentication and authorisation the easy path. Success requires strong hands-on identity engineering skill with an AI first mindset, a collaborative and proactive way of thinking, clear communication, and the ability to balance reliable day-to-day operations with continuous improvement in a fast-moving environment. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Build and run the workforce identity platform, and integrate Easygo’s applications, services and AI agents with it, from sign-on and MFA to provisioning and service-to-service authentication. Build identity for AI agents: every agent has an accountable identity with scoped, delegated access, so we always know who it is, who it acts for and what it can do. Automate the identity lifecycle so access follows HR data and policy. Manage identity as code and automate manual work, using AI coding agents as part of how you build and run the platform. Use risk signals and identity threat detection to stop risky sign-ins and respond automatically. Build an AI-native identity operation. Use agents to automate onboarding, access requests and lifecycle tasks, with humans approving high-impact actions. Support identity governance and privileged access as they mature, and extend them to non-human and agent identities. Your track record: Essential Strong software or platform engineering background. You write production-quality code (e.g. Python, TypeScript or Go) and work with REST APIs, Git and CI/CD every day. Strong demonstration of AI-first engineering: AI coding agents are part of how you build, and you use agentic workflows to run operations, such as automating routine tasks, triaging issues and drafting fixes, with the right guardrails and human review. Deep, practical understanding of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML and SCIM: what goes in a token and why, how each flow works, and how each one gets attacked. Hands-on experience engineering a modern workforce identity platform, including at least one identity migration. PingOne (including DaVinci) experience is a strong plus. Manages configuration as code with Terraform, pull requests and automated pipelines. Bonus points if you also have: Understands identity and security for AI agents: agent identity, delegated (on-behalf-of) access, scoped short-lived credentials, MCP authorisation and prompt-injection risks. Hands-on with identity architecture patterns: identity-aware proxy, workload identity, token exchange and delegation, federation across organisations. Has implemented privileged access (just-in-time access, session brokering) at enterprise scale. Background in a technology, gaming or high-growth environment operating across multiple regions. Benefits that give you the Easygo Edge, so you can build the future of fearless tech with us: Disrupt: we push boundaries and play to win Ballots for major sporting and music events Time with our partners and ambassadors, and exclusive office sessions with leading streamers, creators and industry guests Spin the Wheel Fridays on your birthday and work anniversary, with prizes up to $1,000 or a car EV subscriptions, novated leasing, energy savings through Origin, and everyday discounts and cash back through Paylab Rewards Evolve: we’re in constant motion, personally and professionally The ultimate sandbox: 1 in 3 of our people level up their role every year. If you deliver, you move. Market-synced pay, a performance-based bonus and a high-value referral bonus 30 days combined annual and personal leave for full-time employees 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers and 2 weeks for secondary carers, plus a 12-week return to work with fully paid Fridays off Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, and 7% off Bupa health cover with extras waiting periods waived Wednesday massages, a meditation space, parenting facilities, and bike storage, lockers and showers for active commuters Unify: we move as one and win together Daily catered breakfast, free barista coffee, juices and smoothies, and snack walls and drink fridges on every floor Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles, an F1 simulator, social sports teams and the Corporate Games Mid-year and end-of-year celebrations, team budgets for wins and milestones, and a paid volunteer day each year Benefits apply to Australian-based employees, are subject to eligibility and program terms, and may change. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Research Scientist, Life Sciences (Computational Chemistry)
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist who combines deep chemistry knowledge with machine learning expertise to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be a computational chemist who knows reactions, synthesis, and medicinal chemistry in depth and has hands-on experience training and evaluating machine learning models. Above all, you'll build the reinforcement learning environments, datasets, and evaluations that teach Claude chemistry. Working alongside our bench chemists and AI researchers, you'll turn real chemistry problems and experimental data into training tasks and measure whether the models get better at them. This role is fully on-site in the San Francisco Bay Area. Key responsibilities Design and build reinforcement learning environments for chemistry end to end, including task design, data curation, automated grading, and checks against shortcuts and data leakage Design and source new experimental datasets, environments, and evaluations with our bench chemists, and external research and academic partners Develop evaluations that measure model performance on real chemistry tasks, such as reaction outcome prediction, synthesis planning, structure elucidation, and compound design, and feed results back to research teams Run and analyze training experiments with AI research teams, diagnose where models fail at chemistry, and prioritize what to build next Ensure datasets and environments are high quality and well documented, including sources, train and test splits, and failure modes Communicate findings clearly to chemistry, AI research, and life sciences audiences Minimum qualifications PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, or a related field Deep knowledge of organic and medicinal chemistry, including reactions, synthesis, and SAR, with experimental data as your ground truth Strong Python skills and solid machine learning fundamentals, with hands-on experience training and evaluating models Comfort navigating ambiguity and defining problems in a rapidly evolving research environment Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams, with strong written and verbal communication skills Preferred qualifications Experience with reinforcement learning, large language models, or building evaluations and benchmarks Track record of supporting drug discovery programs alongside medicinal and synthetic chemists Experience curating chemistry datasets from the literature, patents, or lab notebooks, including reaction, ADMET, and spectroscopic data Cheminformatics and molecular modeling skills, for example RDKit, docking, free energy calculations, or quantum chemistry Hands-on synthetic or medicinal chemistry experience at the bench Publications, patents, or open-source software demonstrating scientific impact The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Procurement team makes working with the world easy, fast, and safe. We connect supplier readiness, purchasing, invoicing, and payment so teams can move with confidence as OpenAI scales. About the Role We’re looking for a Procurement Operations Manager to support subcontracting and intercompany purchasing and payment coordination for a growing deployment business. You will keep agreements, staffing changes and purchase order (PO) funding aligned, and own the research, supplier communication and follow-through needed to resolve issues. Accounts Payable (AP) handles invoice processing and payments; Accounting owns accounting decisions. You will also manage subcontracting workflows in our deployment operations platform and use OpenAI technology to automate repeatable steps. This combines hands-on operations with building and testing practical AI workflows that improve speed, accuracy and service as the business grows. Location: San Francisco, CA. This role follows a hybrid work model, with three days per week in the office (Monday–Wednesday). In this role, you will: - Coordinate subcontracting and purchasing from intake through completion: prepare agreement and amendment inputs, track reviews and signatures, and execute approved PO requests and changes. - Translate staffing, scope, term and engagement-value changes into coordinated updates to agreements, PO funding and billing schedules. Keep the source documents and transaction records connected. - Lead research and supplier issue remediation across contracts, POs, invoices and payments. Identify the cause, secure corrections, keep suppliers informed and give AP complete supporting evidence. Follow each issue through resolution. - Serve as the primary contact for intercompany invoice and payment status. Follow up with approvers, investigate stalled handoffs, and coordinate procurement and ERP system issues with AP, Accounting and Finance Systems through resolution. Keep stakeholders informed of progress and next steps. - Own subcontracting workflow requirements for the deployment operations platform. Build practical AI support for intake, extracting terms, preparing drafts, comparing records and researching exceptions. Test outputs against current sources and validate calculations. - Partner with Procurement Enablement and Finance Systems to improve workflows and integrations. Measure cycle time, rework, issue aging and time saved, then use the results to prioritize improvements. You might thrive in this role if you: - Bring hands-on experience in procurement, procure-to-pay, finance operations or a related field, with a record of independently following work through to completion. - Understand how agreements, approvals, PO funding, invoices and payments connect. You can investigate discrepancies, explain findings to suppliers and coordinate a supported resolution with AP and Accounting. - Bring practical AI fluency and experience improving workflows with automation. You can show what you built, how you validated results and what improved. - Work confidently with spreadsheets and procurement or ERP systems, investigate transaction and workflow issues, and coordinate fixes with system owners. - Build trust through responsive service, careful listening and proactive communication with employees, suppliers and stakeholders. Exercise sound judgment with incomplete information and urgent requests, and follow through to resolution. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to strengthen the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our production services. In this hands-on individual-contributor role, you’ll design, build, and operate resilient cloud infrastructure; improve service reliability against meaningful SLOs; and help teams respond to production issues through effective observability, incident practices, and blameless learning. You’ll contribute technical expertise to system and architectural decisions and partner with engineers across the organization to deliver dependable systems. Glean’s rapid growth brings complex distributed-systems challenges across a hybrid cloud environment. You’ll use your software engineering and SRE skills to automate repetitive work, build tools, and improve deployment, monitoring, and on-call workflows. From investigating incidents and reducing toil to optimizing performance, capacity, and cost, your work will help Glean scale while providing customers with a reliable experience. You will: Technical Leadership and Mentorship : Play a key role in driving technical excellence and fostering a culture of reliability across engineering teams. You will lead by example, setting best practices for incident management, performance optimization, and automation. Influence best practices, drive cross-team collaborations, and contribute to the execution of key objectives in alignment with engineering leadership and cross-functional partners. Establish strong technical credibility, shaping architectural decisions and ensuring the delivery of high-quality, reliable systems. Ensure High Availability: Implement and maintain resilient cloud architectures, monitor system performance, and proactively identify and resolve potential bottlenecks or points of failure. Incident Management: Participate in primary oncall rotation; cultivate technical curiosity and growth mindset, and a blameless postmortem culture within the team. Continuously optimize the on-call process for sustainability and efficiency. Automation and Tooling: Develop and maintain automation scripts, tools, and processes to streamline system deployment, monitoring, and management tasks. Your contributions will be vital in efficiently scaling cloud operations. Performance Optimization: Optimize cloud infrastructure and applications for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness. Security and Compliance: Collaborate with security engineers to implement best practices and ensure compliance with security standards and policies. Monitoring and Alerting: Design and configure advanced monitoring systems to gain insights into system behavior, set up alerts, and respond proactively to potential issues. Create and maintain comprehensive dashboards and playbooks for production on-call. Software Development Consultation: Engage actively in the entire software development lifecycle. Participate in system design reviews and provide valuable SRE insights during launch reviews, influencing and enhancing system architecture. About you: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in a senior-level role within Site Reliability Engineering or similar role, particularly in managing cloud-based services and infrastructure. 5+ years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. 3+ years of experience leading projects and designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting distributed systems running in Cloud. Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Azure. Practical experience with containerization technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes. Familiarity with infrastructure as code tools like Terraform is essential. Solid understanding of networking, security principles, and best SRE and security practices. Proficiency in using monitoring and alerting tools to detect and respond to potential issues effectively Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View Office) Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $260,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement . items.title: Solutions Engineer, LATAM
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a Solutions Engineer to help enterprise customers across Latin America turn complex information and AI challenges into practical business outcomes. You will partner with Account Executives throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design through tailored demonstrations, technical evaluations, and purchase decisions. This is not a demo-only role: you will help customers validate the right use cases and create a credible path from technical evidence to a business decision. You will: Lead technical discovery with enterprise customers, uncovering business goals, workflows, technical requirements, stakeholders, decision criteria, and risks. Design and deliver tailored demonstrations, architecture workshops, and customer presentations that connect Glean’s capabilities to specific customer outcomes. Lead technical evaluations and proofs of value with agreed scope, measurable success criteria, clear customer responsibilities, and decision gates. Explain enterprise AI, search, and SaaS architecture—including integrations, data flows, identity and permissions, security, and operational tradeoffs—to technical and business audiences. Help customers evaluate build-versus-buy choices by surfacing lifecycle effort, security, maintenance, and ownership considerations without relying on FUD. Build value cases for strategic opportunities, including customer-specific ROI and procurement-ready business rationale. Partner closely with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, map stakeholders, align on meeting objectives, and create clear next steps while maintaining distinct AE and SE ownership. Multi-thread technical and executive relationships and help maintain momentum when stakeholders or evaluation requirements change. Bring customer insights, product gaps, and competitive patterns back to Product, Engineering, and the broader Solutions Engineering team. Create reusable regional demos, technical guidance, and field learnings that help the team execute consistently. About you: Approximately 3+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, technical pre-sales, solution architecture, technical consulting, or comparable customer-facing technical work in enterprise SaaS. Strong technical discovery and solution-design skills, with the ability to ask precise questions, make assumptions explicit, and explain integration, identity, security, and architecture tradeoffs. Experience delivering customer-specific demonstrations, workshops, or technical evaluations and adapting your explanation for both engineers and executives. The judgment to define a useful proof of value: why it is needed, what it will prove, how success will be measured, and what decision follows. The ability to translate technical fit into business value, including the confidence to recommend a narrower evaluation—or no evaluation—when that best serves the customer. Experience working with technical buyers and partnering with Sales and cross-functional teams through complex customer decisions. Fluent Spanish and Portuguese for customer-facing conversations and materials across the role’s regional coverage, and professional English for internal collaboration. Curiosity and learning agility in enterprise AI, search, and modern SaaS platforms, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly without overstating what a product does. Clear written communication, dependable follow-through, and a collaborative approach to working across countries, functions, and stakeholder groups. Experience with enterprise AI, search, knowledge management, data platforms, developer tools, enterprise integrations, APIs, cloud platforms, identity and access management, security reviews, competitive evaluations, ROI models, technical business cases, reusable demos, or regional enablement materials is helpful but not required. Location: This role is remote and must be based in Latin America. São Paulo or Mexico City is preferred; remote candidates elsewhere in LATAM may be considered based on role coverage and local hiring feasibility. Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to our 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-REMOTE AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants: Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement . items.description: We're hiring a Compensation Lead to build Perplexity's compensation function and own its day-to-day execution. You'll build the programs and processes that support how we hire, recognize, and retain people. You should be comfortable moving between program design and an individual offer, building longer-term structure while keeping today's decisions moving. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Build the compensation foundation. Assess existing practices, data, and tools; prioritize the gaps; and develop recommendations on compensation philosophy, market positioning, and cash and equity guidelines. - Develop salary ranges and market benchmarks. Establish a consistent approach to pricing roles across functions and locations. Partner with People and business leaders on job scope and leveling, and explain where market data is useful or incomplete. - Own day-to-day compensation decisions. Be the primary partner for offers, promotions, pay adjustments, and compensation questions. Evaluate recommendations against market data, internal equity, and budget, with clear approval paths for exceptions. - Design and run compensation reviews. Build the calendar, planning models, manager guidance, and approval process. Coordinate with Finance, People Operations, Payroll, and equity partners to carry decisions through to accurate implementation. - Inform leadership decisions. Model the cost and employee impact of proposed changes to salary and equity programs. Present a recommendation and its trade-offs, then own execution once approved. - Identify and address inconsistencies. Assess pay compression and potential inequities across teams, levels, and locations. Partner with People leadership and Legal on appropriate reviews and recommend actions. - Build processes people can use. Establish decision records, recruiter and manager guidance, and clear explanations of compensation programs. Improve recurring workflows so consistent decisions don't depend on individual knowledge or one-off conversations. - Own the data and tools behind the work. Establish reliable compensation records, select and manage benchmarking resources, and improve reporting and quality checks. Use approved automation and AI tools where they help, with appropriate protection for employee information and verification of results. WHAT YOU BRING - Experience building compensation programs: You've established or substantially rebuilt compensation frameworks and processes with limited infrastructure, and stayed accountable for running them after launch. - Technical compensation depth: Hands-on experience with market pricing, salary ranges, cash and equity programs, compensation reviews, and individual pay recommendations. - Strong analytical judgment: You can build and audit models, reconcile imperfect data, and explain your assumptions. You know when a benchmark is a useful comparison and when it misses the role. - Ability to influence decisions: You can turn analysis into a clear recommendation, discuss trade-offs with leadership, and constructively challenge an approach that isn't working. - Independent, hands-on execution: You can set priorities, build a workable process, and manage urgent requests without losing progress on longer-term work. You're comfortable being both the person designing the program and the person checking the data. - Discretion and clear communication: You handle sensitive information carefully and explain compensation decisions in language that recruiters, managers, and employees can understand.

items.title: Engineering Technician, Actuators
items.description: About the Team Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings. Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve peoples’ lives. About the Role We are seeking Engineering Technicians to support the assembly, testing, and prototyping of custom electromechanical actuators for advanced robotic systems. You will build and test hardware from engineering drawings and procedures through inspection, troubleshooting, and rework, partnering closely with mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, and test engineers. These roles focus on hands-on work with precision electromechanical hardware, including stator prototypes, motor and actuator assemblies, and mechanical and electrical testing. You will help turn engineering designs into validated hardware while improving build records, work instructions, and repeatable assembly and test practices for future robotic platforms. This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and requires in-person presence 5 days a week. In this role, you will: Each opening focuses on actuator builds, testing, or stator prototyping, with responsibilities aligned to the selected specialty. - Actuator builds: assemble subassemblies and complete actuators from drawings, bills of materials, and work instructions, checking fit, orientation, torque, routing, and workmanship. - Testing: set up and run established mechanical and electrical tests, confirm the setup against the procedure, record measurements, and identify unexpected results. - Stator prototyping: support winding, insulation, termination, bonding, inspection, and rework using the selected build process and documented instructions. - Troubleshoot build and test issues with engineers. Isolate problems through inspection and measurement, escalate deviations, and verify the result after approved rework. - Maintain accurate build and test records, part and revision traceability, inspection results, and rework history. - Use bench observations to improve work instructions, fixtures, tooling, and parts organization as prototypes evolve. - Follow safety, ESD, cleanliness, and quality practices, and communicate material shortages, unclear instructions, and other blockers as priorities change. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have hands-on experience building or testing mechanical, electrical, or electromechanical hardware in a lab, prototype shop, or manufacturing environment. - Can work from drawings, bills of materials, wiring diagrams, and procedures, and recognize when the instructions and hardware do not agree. - Use hand tools, torque tools, and measurement equipment carefully, with consistent workmanship and attention to units and acceptance limits. - Troubleshoot methodically, document observations, and know when to pause work and ask for engineering support. - Take ownership of build quality and records while adapting to changing designs and priorities. items.title: Trust and Safety Program Manager
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized “house,” Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Trust & Safety protects the platform, keeps our users safe and builds trust with the people we depend on for our growth. This role straddles between program management of Polymarket US, a CFTC-regulated exchange, and on the Polymarket DeFi platform. Every product Polymarket ships reaches traders in a regulated market, so each launch, each user protection and each response to an incident has to hold up with users, regulators and the public. As the function's first Program Manager, reporting to the Global Head of Trust & Safety, you will own those programs end to end: launch readiness for new products, markets and jurisdictions; the controls and evidence behind Polymarket's regulatory commitments; user protections such as self-exclusion, deposit limits and behavioral monitoring; and incident response. You will set how each program runs, partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, and report to leadership what each program delivers. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own launch readiness for new products, markets and jurisdictions on the exchange and on DeFi: tier every launch, run the go or no-go, and secure written sign-off from Legal, Compliance and Trust & Safety before each major launch - Turn regulatory obligations and commitments into controls, procedures and evidence, and keep the record ready for any regulator inquiry or exam - Bring risk review and user protection requirements into each launch from the first spec, including what the launch can and cannot claim publicly - Launch and monitor user protections such as self-exclusion, deposit limits, behavioral monitoring and trusted-contact tools, and drive them from scoping to adoption - Run DeFi restriction programs, including self-certification and close-only, from flag to enforcement - Lead the program side of Trust & Safety incidents, and build and drill the crisis playbook with Compliance, Customer Experience, Legal and Communications - Take partners and vendors from pilot to contract, with a success measure agreed before each pilot starts - Own the metrics and the cadence: quarterly goals, the weekly Trust & Safety update and business reviews - Build and run Trust & Safety's intake process for partner teams WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years in program or technical program management, including 3+ in trust and safety, risk, integrity, responsible gaming, fraud or compliance at a regulated platform - You have run a launch risk-review process that product teams used, and can name launches it stopped or changed - You have led or run the program side of a live incident with user harm or regulatory exposure - You have prepared evidence for a regulator, auditor or exam, and turned a regulatory obligation into a control or procedure - You have built a program at a company that had none - You have taken a vendor or partner from pilot to contract - You pull and reconcile your own data (SQL or equivalent) - You write short, dated decision documents with an owner on every line - You are comfortable as the only program person in the function (Plus) CFTC, NFA or exchange experience (Plus) Responsible gaming programs or player protection (Plus) Crypto, DeFi or onchain compliance BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $165,000 to $190,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

We are looking for a Data Centre Operations Engineer to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. items.title: Legal Counsel - US
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ROLE SUMMARY As Legal Counsel, you’ll be an early member of the Mistral legal team in the US, which forms part of the global legal team. The core of this role is (a) drafting and negotiating commercial agreements to support the growth of our business in North America and (b) supporting the development of AI tools to scale Mistral’s legal operations. As part of a start-up legal team, you’ll need to be nimble enough to quickly ramp up on new areas of law, such as product matters (privacy, marketing, and regulatory compliance), intellectual property, and other matters, as needed. You should be comfortable with charting new paths and interested in designing the legal department of the future. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts across the business, including customer MSAs and order forms and partnership agreements. - Collaborate with a cross-functional group of Mistral’s technical (including engineering, applied AI, and science), business, and legal teams. - Improve and develop tools to facilitate and automate legal workflows and approval processes, compliance with and creation of company policies, and internal training materials and guides. - Refine and create templates to scale with the company as it grows. - Provide solution-oriented legal, regulatory, and strategic advice and direction to teams across our company, from the initial stages of project development to launch and beyond. - Efficiently manage and work with outside counsel to support projects you manage. - Stay up-to-date and ensure compliance with U.S. and international laws and regulations that apply to AI technologies, including AI-specific regulations, privacy and data protection, competition, consumer protection, payments, and intellectual property. - Build positive relationships across the company and with its external partners. - Occasional travel to Paris headquarters is encouraged. WHO YOU ARE - JD from an accredited law school and member in good standing of a U.S. state bar. - 4+ years of law firm and/or in-house experience, including experience in project management. In-house experience at a technology company and/or in a fast-paced and high-growth environment is a strong plus. - Experience managing technology implementation/solutions projects to meet corporate operational standards. - Experience drafting and negotiating commercial agreements, including creating and refining form agreements. - Fluency in common AI tools, and a track record of responsibly using AI technologies to drive efficiency and process improvement. - Generalist skill set with the willingness to tackle problems outside your core expertise. - Ability to balance an attention to detail with the requirements of a fast-paced company. - Demonstrated business and pragmatic judgment, and the ability to analyze the costs/benefits of proposed resolutions to complex legal and technical problems. - Proven ability to build solid, trusting, and credible relationships, including working closely with science, engineering, business, and marketing teams. - Excellent writing, communication, and people skills. - An understanding of AI technologies and their applications, including how they intersect with relevant areas of law, such as privacy and data protection, competition, and intellectual property, and related ethical considerations such as fairness, transparency, accountability, and bias mitigation - An international mindset and experience is a plus. - Given the rapidly evolving nature of AI technologies and the legal landscape surrounding them, you should be adaptable and willing to continuously learn and update your skills and knowledge. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. items.title: Senior Commercial Counsel, Enterprise
items.description: Perplexity is looking for a senior commercial attorney to join our Legal team. We are looking for an independent, business-practical yet diligent-minded professional who can carry live deals, extend the infrastructure we have already built, and hold the line on the terms that matter as deal volume, complexity, and regulatory surface all grow. You will negotiate directly with large enterprise customers across a large variety of industries including financial services, healthcare, government, and other regulated industries, partner daily with Enterprise Sales, Partnerships, Deal Desk, Security, Privacy, Product, and Finance, and advise on the legal questions that come with agentic, retrieval, and API products deployed inside enterprise environments. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who is genuinely a self starter. This role is for you if you get energy from ambiguous, first‑of‑their‑kind problems and enjoy designing repeatable approaches that scale. You default to enabling the business, frame risk in practical terms, and focus on durable structures rather than one‑off fixes. RESPONSIBILITIES - Independently lead end-to-end drafting, review, and negotiation of Enterprise customer agreements across our suite of offerings: Enterprise Pro, Enterprise Max, Computer, and API product lines, including MSAs, order forms, SaaS and API terms, DPAs, BAAs, security exhibits, customer-paper redlines, product-specific addenda, and public-sector vehicles such as GSA MAS orders and federal RFP responses. - Serve as a trusted legal partner to Enterprise Sales, Partnerships, Deal Desk, and Customer Success, providing fast, practical, business-aligned counsel that accelerates deal velocity, protects the terms that matter, and scales as the Sales organization grows. - Extend and maintain the existing Enterprise negotiation playbook, DPA and Privacy Notice architecture, product-specific term libraries, and fallback positions as our product surface, customer mix, and regulatory environment evolve, so that positions compound into reusable precedent rather than being re-litigated deal by deal. - Advise on AI-specific contract terms for enterprise deployments, including bespoke data postures; negotiate output ownership and liability, agentic-feature risk allocation and translate product operations into enterprise contract commitments. - Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, Finance, and Compliance to surface and address legal risk early, particularly on customer-data flows, enterprise integrations, model routing, and customer-specific compliance requirements. - Monitor the evolving regulatory landscape for enterprise AI, data protection, and public-sector procurement (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, DORA, EU AI Act, sector-specific frameworks) and translate emerging requirements into practical contractual positions and updated playbook guidance. - Represent Perplexity Legal externally on customer negotiation calls with counterparty counsel at sophisticated enterprises. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - Exceptional communicator who owns deadlines, proactively manages internal and external expectations, and escalates early and clearly to protect deal timelines and momentum. - A proactive problem‑solver who defaults to “yes, and” when engaging with internal stakeholders: you look for ways to make deals work, frame risk clearly, and design long‑term, scalable solutions. - A disciplined drafter who favors surgical, minimal‑footprint edits over wholesale rewrites, grounds positions in documented rationale, and preserves material legal meaning and risk allocation under time pressure. - Someone who can articulate complex legal risk and concepts in the form of simple, actionable terms for non‑legal stakeholders, leads with practical “how to make this work” advice, and designs creative, long‑term solutions to novel, cutting‑edge challenges. - Someone genuinely excited by novel, cutting‑edge challenges in AI products and the commercial and regulatory questions they surface, and who enjoys turning ambiguity into clear, reusable approaches. QUALIFICATIONS - JD and in good standing with an active U.S. state bar membership. - At least 7+ years of combined law firm and in-house experience, with a substantial in-house component, and a demonstrated track record of independently owning complex enterprise SaaS or API deals from the vendor side, including work with regulated-industry customers (financial services, healthcare, or government). - Experience advising on commercial terms and pricing structures for high‑growth SaaS/API businesses, including usage‑based and tiered pricing, pilots, and expansion frameworks. - Familiarity with data protection and security frameworks (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, DORA, EU AI Act) and hands-on experience negotiating DPAs. - Strong business acumen and the ability to partner effectively with Sales, Deal Desk, Product, Security, and executive stakeholders on live deals under time pressure. - Proven ability to triage and progress multiple concurrent deals under tight timelines while maintaining rigorous diligence, clear risk assessment, and high‑quality documentation. - Demonstrated ability to build and extend durable legal infrastructure — playbooks, templates, precedent repositories, or self-serve tools. - Ability to communicate clearly with business and technical audiences and to translate legal concepts into usable guidance for non-lawyers, including Sales and Deal Desk. - Hands-on, can-do approach to tackle projects large and small, low-ego approach to working closely with the Director and across the organization, and judgment about when to escalate and when to close. - Positive collaborative attitude, comfort with ambiguity and a fast pace, high level of integrity, and intellectual curiosity about AI technology. NICE TO HAVE - Prior experience with public-sector contracting or with on-prem deployment structures. - Experience with AI-native contracting questions related to agentic products - Experience with contracting with regulated entities (financial institutions or health care), especially in the EU/UK.

You will personally build and execute outbound channels like LinkedIn, email, and outreach, while directing central marketing and Concierge teams for other channels. By implementing a CRM-integrated martech stack, you will orchestrate conversion paths and build marketing attribution to optimize CAC:LTV. This is an exciting opportunity to build a high-priority marketing infrastructure from scratch and make a major business impact! This role is based in our New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Net-new prospect funnel: Personally build and run outbound marketing—including LinkedIn, email, and outreach—to reach a high-net-worth and mass-affluent audience outside our current customer base. Conversion path orchestration: Own both the free expert consultation and self-serve signup paths. Partner with product to lead qualification and routing to expert calendars, nurture no-shows and not-yet-ready leads, and test outreach channels. Channel orchestration via central marketing and Concierge: Set the strategy and brief execution for paid, brand creative, events, and owned/lifecycle channels through the central marketing and Concierge teams. Marketing stack build-out: Implement the marketing technology required to run marketing for this audience, integrating with a CRM (e.g., Salesforce). Launch readiness: Drive marketing execution against a confidential internal timeline. GTM partnership across departments: Partner with central marketing, Concierge, growth, product, and legal/compliance as strategy and budget finalize—understanding project timelines and key marketing outputs, triaging problems in real time, and advocating for the prospective client's needs. Unit-economics ownership: Build and iterate marketing attribution and efficiency, with a primary focus on net-new client acquisition costs relative to lifetime value (CAC:LTV). What you bring 6+ years of experience in B2B or B2B2C demand generation or growth marketing, with hands-on experience building, not just running, campaigns inside an existing stack. Experience creating a marketing stack that pairs outbound channels (LinkedIn, email, outreach) with a live "book a call/demo" conversion flow (marketing automation, lead routing, scheduling, and attribution). Experience marketing a sales-assisted product (such as wealth management, fintech, insurance, or B2B SaaS with a human handoff) where the funnel leads to a live conversation rather than a self-serve signup. Routine use of AI across your marketing workflow, with comfort directing a hybrid workflow of human collaborators and AI tools. Experience shipping outbound campaigns end-to-end, pairing creative assets and messaging with distribution channels, and experience directing other teams or agencies on channels you do not produce yourself.
